notes: SN1987A axion-fireball paper. New bound from Pioneer Venus Orbiter (PVO) excluding the fireball-formation region in the ALP mass-coupling plane (ma ~ few MeV to ~60 MeV, g_agamma ~ 2e-10 to ~1e-8 GeV^-1). The data points give the approximate lower boundary of the excluded fireball region, read off from Figs. 2-3; exact contour not tabulated so values are approximate. Astrophysical SN bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density.
